hero.title: Know which Canadian job actually moves you toward PR.
hero.subtitle: Since March 2025 a job offer has been worth zero CRS points. What still counts is the Canadian experience a role builds, the draw categories it opens, and the provincial streams it unlocks. We score every job on exactly that.
hero.tagline: Built on IRCC's actual round history — not the published category list.
hero.ctaPrimary: See my CRS and open routes

scoreDemo.title: Senior AI Engineer
scoreDemo.caption: One number and one reason. Twelve months in this role takes your CRS from 482 to 522, which clears the recent Canadian Experience Class cut-off of 516 by 6 points.

drawBoard.title: Being eligible is not the same as being invited.
drawBoard.subtitle: IRCC lists ten categories for 2026. Only some are actually being drawn. We track every round, so you aim at doors that open.
drawBoard.stemNote: STEM is the clearest example. It is still on IRCC's 2026 category list, so every tool that reads that list tells software engineers they qualify. No STEM round has been held in over 27 months. We show you that instead of a green checkmark.
drawBoard.sourceNote: Cut-offs are the median of the most recent rounds in each category. Past rounds do not predict future ones.

reviewQueue.title: A real CRS score, not a match percentage
reviewQueue.body: We run the full official Comprehensive Ranking System grid — age, education, language ability, Canadian and foreign experience, spouse factors, skill transferability. You get a number you can compare against actual cut-offs, with every component shown.

pathwayScoring.title: Scored against rounds that actually happened
pathwayScoring.body: Every route is measured against IRCC's real round history: how many invitations it issued, when it last ran, and where its cut-off has sat. A category nobody has been invited from is reported as dormant, not as an opportunity.

permitFilters.title: Told what is closed, and why
permitFilters.body: If you do not qualify for a route, we say so and name the missing piece — the twelve months of experience, the NCLC 7 in French, the nomination. Where our occupation list has not been verified against IRCC, we flag it rather than guess.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps from your profile to a job that changes your odds.
